## Upstream changes 1.19.0 -> 1.20.0

**Verdict:** NEEDS ATTENTION — no companion-service version mismatch, but this upgrade changes how Docker env files are loaded, adds new Celery queues and a reverse-proxy route the template must supply, requires `docker compose up -d` (not a plain restart), and ships six new Alembic migrations.

### Breaking changes
- `docker/envs/core-services/shared.env` is **no longer loaded**: *"`docker/envs/core-services/shared.env` is **no longer loaded**. Move common API, worker, and Beat settings to `api-worker.env` before recreating containers."* This template's compose file does not use `shared.env`/`api-worker.env` at all (it sets shared values via the `x-app-env` anchor and `.env`), so this specific migration step does not apply here — but any operator who hand-edited a `shared.env` copy for this stack must move those settings into `.env`/the compose anchor instead.
- New Celery queues `human_input_delivery` and `human_input_contact_sync` are required: *"Custom `CELERY_QUEUES`, `CELERY_WORKER_QUEUES`, or Celery `--queues` lists must provide an active consumer for each queue alongside existing subscriptions."* The template's `worker` service does not set `CELERY_QUEUES`/`CELERY_WORKER_QUEUES` explicitly (it relies on image defaults), so this is likely already covered — confirm the image's default queue list includes both before relying on it.
- New reverse-proxy route required for HITL IM webhooks: *"In `WEBHOOK` mode, forward `/callbacks/human-input/v2/im/` to the API service... The bundled nginx template already includes this rule; add its equivalent to custom nginx, Ingress, or other reverse proxy configurations."* This template vendors Dify's own nginx config (not a custom reimplementation), so it should already carry this rule — but CI's drift check against upstream nginx config must be confirmed green for 1.20.0 before trusting it blindly.
- `docker compose up -d` is required to pick up environment file changes: *"Apply changes with `docker compose up -d`; a plain restart does not reload environment files."*
- Plain Docker image behavior change, not app code: `OPENAPI_ENABLED` now defaults to `true` (was `false`), exposing `/openapi/v1/*` endpoints by default.

### Variables
- `OPENAPI_ENABLED`: default flips `true` (was `false`) — exposes OpenAPI endpoints unless explicitly set to `false`. Not currently in `.env.example`; add explicitly if this should stay closed.
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_HITL_IM`: default flips `true` (was `false`) — enables New HITL IM/Contacts/approval UI by default. Not currently in `.env.example`.
- `HUMAN_INPUT_GLOBAL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`, `HUMAN_INPUT_IM_EVENT_TRANSPORT_MODE`, `FILE_SCAN_ENABLED` (and related `FILE_SCAN_*` vars), `NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_AGENT_V2_IN_CHATFLOW`, `DEEPEVAL_DISABLE_DOTENV`/`DEEPEVAL_TELEMETRY_OPT_OUT` — all new, all default off/safe except as noted above. None currently appear in `.env.example`; they'll fall back to image defaults unless added.
- `DIFY_AGENT_OPENSHELL_SHARED_MOUNT_PATH`: removed upstream ("Shared-volume Home Snapshots are no longer supported by the OpenShell backend"). Not present in this template's `.env.example` or compose file — no action needed.
- `DIFY_AGENT_OPENSHELL_DRIVER_CONFIG`: now optional upstream. Not present in this template — no action needed (this template runs `DIFY_AGENT_RUNTIME_BACKEND=local`, not OpenShell).
- `EXPERIMENTAL_ENABLE_VINEXT`: removed from Web Docker image builds. The template's `.env.example` still sets `EXPERIMENTAL_ENABLE_VINEXT=false` — this line is now a no-op and can be deleted, but leaving it does no harm since Compose simply ignores an env var the image no longer reads.
- `TRIGGER_URL`: notes say *"Set to the public HTTPS API origin for IM callbacks... Update the IM provider configuration when this origin changes."* The template already derives `TRIGGER_URL: https://${DIFY_HOSTNAME}` in the compose `x-app-env` block — this is an existing template behavior, not a new requirement from this release.
- New `envs/core-services/urls.defaults` / `urls.env` consolidation for public URLs — this template already derives all nine public URLs from `DIFY_HOSTNAME` directly in compose (`x-app-env`), bypassing the urls.env mechanism entirely. No action needed; the template's approach supersedes this upstream file reorganization.

### Data and dependencies
- Six new Alembic migrations, head moves from `53c10126d551` to `f8b6e2c4a901`: adds `human_input_im_sync_runs` column, personal access token tables, file scanner tables, Evaluation tables (apply to CE too, even though unused), and a migration-branch merge. Notes state: *"none of the six revisions require a separate manual backfill command."* `MIGRATION_ENABLED=true` (already the template default) handles this automatically via `api`/`worker`/`worker_beat`.
- Plugin daemon bump to `0.6.15-local` is already reflected in this repo's compose file (`plugin-daemon: ...0.6.15-local@sha256:14aebd...`) and `.env.example` default — correctly pre-applied, not an outstanding action.
- OpenShell-specific requirements (gateway 0.1.3+, `DIFY_AGENT_OPENSHELL_SHELLCTL_AUTH_TOKEN` rotation, runtime image rebuild) do not apply: this template runs `DIFY_AGENT_RUNTIME_BACKEND=local` with the local sandbox, not OpenShell.
- No companion-service version requirement (Postgres/Redis/Weaviate) is named in these notes, so the verdict is not forced to DO NOT APPLY UNATTENDED on that ground.

### Before applying
- Back up the database, Weaviate volume, app storage, plugin daemon volume, and `.env` before upgrading, per upstream: *"Back up your database, vector-store data, uploaded files, plugin daemon storage, Agent workspace storage, deployment secrets, and environment files."*
- Bump the four coupled image pins together in the compose `x-images` block: `DIFY_API_IMAGE_VERSION`, `DIFY_WEB_IMAGE_VERSION`, `DIFY_LOCAL_SANDBOX_IMAGE_VERSION`, `DIFY_AGENT_BACKEND_IMAGE_VERSION`, all to `1.20.0`, keeping plugin daemon at `0.6.15-local` (already pinned there).
- Decide and set `OPENAPI_ENABLED=false` in `.env` explicitly if you do not want `/openapi/v1/*` reachable by default.
- Decide and set `NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_HITL_IM=false` in `.env` explicitly if you do not want the new HITL approval UI active by default; otherwise plan for the `TRIGGER_URL`-based IM webhook callback route (already present via vendored nginx config) and confirm the worker consumes the two new Celery queues.
- Confirm (via CI's nginx drift check or manual diff) that the vendored `nginx/conf.d/default.conf.template` for 1.20.0 includes the new `/callbacks/human-input/v2/im/` route before enabling HITL IM.
- Use `docker compose stop -t -1`, pull, then `docker compose up -d` (not a bare restart) so migrations run and env files reload, per the standard sequence in the notes.
- Keep `SECRET_KEY`, `PASSWORD_PEPPER` (if set), and the Local sandbox auth token unchanged across the upgrade, per upstream guidance.

### Notes read
- `langgenius/dify` release notes for `1.20.0` (full body) and `1.19.0` (baseline, read for context only — no action items taken from it beyond confirming what was already true at the current version).

## Upstream changes 1.19.0 -> 1.20.0

**Verdict:** NEEDS ATTENTION — the image itself pins cleanly (agent-backend, api, web, local-sandbox all move to 1.20.0 together), but the release carries a retired-env-file change, two new mandatory Celery queues, and a new reverse-proxy route that this template's vendored nginx config must carry, none of which can be confirmed applied without a manual check.

Note: "WHAT THE IMAGES THEMSELVES DIFFER IN" could not be read from the registry (`HTTPError: HTTP Error 400: Bad Request`). Nothing in this report about container user, entrypoint, command, ports, volumes, healthcheck or environment is image-verified — it is drawn from the release notes alone, as the instructions require when that section is empty.

### Breaking changes
- **`docker/envs/core-services/shared.env` is no longer loaded.** *"`docker/envs/core-services/shared.env` is **no longer loaded**. Move common API, worker, and Beat settings to `api-worker.env` before recreating containers."* This template's compose file does not reference `shared.env` or `api-worker.env` at all (it uses `env_file: .env` plus the `x-app-env` anchor), so this only matters if the operator separately adopted upstream's `envs/core-services/` layout outside this template's compose file.
- **New mandatory Celery queues.** *"New Celery queues: Include `human_input_delivery` ... and `human_input_contact_sync` ... Custom `CELERY_QUEUES`, `CELERY_WORKER_QUEUES`, or Celery `--queues` lists must provide an active consumer for each queue alongside existing subscriptions."* The template does not set `CELERY_QUEUES`/`CELERY_WORKER_QUEUES` in the compose file or `.env.example`, so the worker uses upstream's default queue list and should pick these up automatically — but this needs confirming against the installed `.env` if an operator customized those variables.
- **New HITL IM is now on by default.** *"`NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_HITL_IM` | `true` (was `false`) | Enable New HITL IM, Contacts, V2 editing/migration, and the approval UI. Restart Web and reload the page after changing this value."* This exposes new approval/contact UI and a new webhook-reachable API route after upgrade with no action taken.
- **`OPENAPI_ENABLED` now defaults to true.** *"`OPENAPI_ENABLED` | `true` (was `false`) | Enable `/openapi/v1/*` endpoints by default..."* This opens a previously-disabled API surface by default.
- **New reverse-proxy route required for HITL webhooks.** *"In `WEBHOOK` mode, forward `/callbacks/human-input/v2/im/` to the API service (`api:5001` in Docker Compose) ... The bundled nginx template already includes this rule; add its equivalent to custom nginx, Ingress, or other reverse proxy configurations."* This template vendors its own copy of Dify's nginx config under `nginx/`, checked against upstream by CI at the pinned version — confirm the vendored `default.conf.template` was updated to include this route before relying on IM callbacks.
- **`DIFY_AGENT_OPENSHELL_SHARED_MOUNT_PATH` removed; Home Snapshots over shared volume no longer supported.** Not applicable: this template runs `DIFY_AGENT_RUNTIME_BACKEND=local` with `local_sandbox`, not OpenShell, so this is moot here.
- **`EXPERIMENTAL_ENABLE_VINEXT` removed.** *"Removed from `web.defaults` and Web Docker image builds."* `.env.example` in this template still carries `EXPERIMENTAL_ENABLE_VINEXT=false` — harmless if the web image ignores it, but it is dead configuration after this upgrade.

### Variables
- `OPENAPI_ENABLED` — not present in this template's `.env.example`; will silently take upstream's new default of `true` unless explicitly set.
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_HITL_IM` — not present in `.env.example`; will silently take the new default `true`.
- `HUMAN_INPUT_GLOBAL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`, `HUMAN_INPUT_IM_EVENT_TRANSPORT_MODE` — new, not present in `.env.example`; defaults apply (`604800`, `WEBHOOK`).
- `TRIGGER_URL` — already set by the compose file (`x-app-env`, derived from `DIFY_HOSTNAME`), consistent with the notes' instruction to set it to "the public HTTPS API origin for IM callbacks." No action needed.
- `NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_AGENT_V2_IN_CHATFLOW` — new, defaults to `false`; not in `.env.example`.
- `FILE_SCAN_ENABLED` and related `FILE_SCAN_*` variables — new, default `false`/safe; not in `.env.example`.
- `DATASET_DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH` — new; *"Restart the API after changing this value"* if ever customized.
- `DIFY_AGENT_OPENSHELL_SHARED_MOUNT_PATH` — removed upstream; irrelevant here (local sandbox backend, not OpenShell).
- `EXPERIMENTAL_ENABLE_VINEXT` — removed upstream; still present as a stale line in this template's `.env.example` and should be deleted on next template maintenance pass, not deployment-blocking.
- `CONSOLE_API_URL`, `CONSOLE_WEB_URL`, `SERVICE_API_URL`, `APP_API_URL`, `APP_WEB_URL` — upstream now centralizes these in `envs/core-services/urls.defaults`/`urls.env`; this template already sets all of them directly in the compose file's `x-app-env` block from `DIFY_HOSTNAME`, which is equivalent in effect and needs no change.

### Data and dependencies
- Six new Alembic revisions, head moves from `53c10126d551` to `f8b6e2c4a901`: *"adds **six migration revisions** ... Apply the complete Alembic chain through the normal migration runner."* No manual backfill required: *"none of the six revisions require a separate manual backfill command."* `MIGRATION_ENABLED=true` is already the template default, so `api` applies this automatically on start.
- No companion-service version requirement (database, cache, search engine) is named anywhere in these notes for this range. Weaviate, Postgres, and Redis pins in the compose file are untouched by this release and are not implicated by the notes, so the "no SAFE TO APPLY without a named companion pin" rule does not trigger here.
- Plugin daemon moves to `0.6.15-local`, matching this template's `x-images` pin for `plugin-daemon` already at `0.6.15-local@sha256:...` — already correctly pinned, no action.
- `init_permissions` behavior is unchanged in function but upstream notes it now also prepares `./volumes/plugin_daemon` for UID 1001: *"`init_permissions` now also prepares `./volumes/plugin_daemon` for the daemon's UID 1001, and the daemon waits for it to complete."* This template's `init_permissions` service only chowns `dify-app-storage`, not a plugin-daemon volume — worth checking whether the plugin daemon volume in this template needs the same treatment, since its `plugin_daemon` service has no analogous init step today.

### Before applying
- Back up the database, Weaviate volume, uploaded files (`dify-app-storage`), plugin daemon storage (`dify-plugin-daemon`), and `.env`, per *"Back up your database, vector-store data, uploaded files, plugin daemon storage, Agent workspace storage, deployment secrets, and environment files."*
- Bump `DIFY_API_IMAGE_VERSION`, `DIFY_WEB_IMAGE_VERSION`, `DIFY_LOCAL_SANDBOX_IMAGE_VERSION`, and `DIFY_AGENT_BACKEND_IMAGE_VERSION` together to `1.20.0`, per *"Use matching `1.20.0` API, worker, Web, Agent Backend, and Local sandbox images."* The compose file's `x-images` block controls this; update the defaults there (or set the four `*_IMAGE_VERSION` overrides in `.env`) in lockstep.
- Keep `SECRET_KEY` (`DIFY_SECRET_KEY`), `PASSWORD_PEPPER` if configured, and `DIFY_AGENT_LOCAL_SANDBOX_AUTH_TOKEN` unchanged across the upgrade, per *"Keep `SECRET_KEY`, any configured `PASSWORD_PEPPER`, and the Local sandbox authentication token unchanged."*
- Confirm this template's vendored `nginx/conf.d/default.conf.template` forwards `/callbacks/human-input/v2/im/` to `api:5001` before relying on IM-based human-input approvals; this is new in 1.20.0 and the template's CI check against upstream nginx config should be re-run at the 1.20.0 tag to confirm it picked up the rule.
- Confirm no custom `CELERY_QUEUES`/`CELERY_WORKER_QUEUES` override is set anywhere outside this template's default `.env`; if one is, add `human_input_delivery` and `human_input_contact_sync` to it.
- Run `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d` after bumping the pins — a plain restart does not reload environment files, per *"Apply changes with `docker compose up -d`; a plain restart does not reload environment files."*
- Leave `MIGRATION_ENABLED=true` (already the template default) so `api` applies the six new Alembic revisions automatically on first start of the new image.
- Decide deliberately whether `OPENAPI_ENABLED` (now true by default) and `NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_HITL_IM` (now true by default) are acceptable to expose; set them explicitly to `false` in `.env` before the upgrade if not.

### Notes read
- `1.20.0` release notes (full body supplied above), covering the 1.19.0 → 1.20.0 range.
- `1.19.0` release notes, supplied as the baseline ("THE RELEASE THE TEMPLATE RUNS NOW"), used only to confirm which requirements predate this range (Docker Compose ≥2.35.0, `ops_trace_v2` queue, package format v2 — all already in effect at 1.19.0 and not re-reported as new here).
